make.sh runs clean for this part (2 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE). Nothing else is furnished: a 1-wide lane has no room for a focal piece without blocking the doorways.
The room check cannot pass yet because shell-east, the ceiling and the upper floor are still stubs in this copy, so walk, light and the render are unverified.
left: Lanterns float: they hang from (72,9,z), and nothing there exists until the shell or roof puts a solid ceiling at y9. Confirm in the merged build with mcd room; if y9 is open, use a standing lantern on a post instead, outside the lane.

No walk or light verdict: the floor at y5 and the partitions at x71/x73 are not built here, so the room check reads 0 floor cells. Re-run `$MCD room build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "P4 upper hall"` after the merge.

No focal piece: the only candidate is a coat rack (fence + banner) at the north dead end (72,6,14). That is safe only if no doorway opens at x71 or x73 on z14; the partition doorways are not in plan.md or rooms.json, so I did not place it.
The hall's 2-high path from the stair top (68,5,18) through the doorways to the rest of the hall is not verified (the doorway cells are unknown until the shell is built).
Render and LOOK step not done: the stubbed shell would show nothing useful.
